icons.name: Xhosa umbhaco

icons.name: Ndebele beaded apron
icons.prompt: A representative Southern Ndebele beaded apron has a broad rectangular panel with geometric color blocks and several long lower tabs. Show white beadwork framing red, blue, green, and black motifs, with visible waist ties and no unrelated jewelry.

icons.name: Mexican Oaxacan huipil
icons.prompt: A representative Oaxacan huipil has a rectangular woven body, a central neck opening, and broad floral embroidery across the chest. Show a coherent regional design with visible panel seams and no tailored waist, distinguishing it from a fitted blouse.

icons.name: Quechua pollera ensemble

icons.name: Bolivian aguayo

icons.name: Chilean chamanto
icons.prompt: A Chilean huaso chamanto is a short rectangular woven overgarment with a central neck opening, broad decorative bands, and fringe along the lower edges. Display it spread front-on, emphasizing its compact reversible textile construction rather than a long generic poncho.

icons.name: Argentine gaucho outfit
icons.prompt: A representative Argentine gaucho outfit combines a plain shirt, loose bombacha trousers gathered at the ankles, a broad woven waist sash, and a neckerchief. Arrange a dark beret above, without a horse, knife, lasso, or theatrical cowboy accessories.

icons.name: Panamanian pollera

icons.name: Inuit amauti

icons.name: Māori korowai cloak
icons.prompt: A Māori korowai cloak has a rectangular woven muka-fiber body covered with numerous dark hanging hukahuka tassels and a carefully finished upper edge. Display it draped open without a wearer, emphasizing the tassels rather than replacing them with a generic all-feather cloak.

icons.name: Samoan puletasi
icons.prompt: A Samoan puletasi is a coordinated two-piece women's outfit with a long fitted tunic and a matching full-length lower garment. Use a bold coherent floral textile and contrasting border decoration, emphasizing the paired garments rather than a single sewn dress.

icons.name: Italian Renaissance gown
icons.prompt: An Italian Renaissance noblewoman's gown from around 1500 is displayed front-on without a wearer. It has a broad square neckline with a fine white chemise visible beneath, a fitted bodice, a long richly gathered skirt, and detachable sleeves tied with ribbons, revealing small puffs of white linen at the shoulders and elbows. Use jewel-toned silk with restrained gold brocade. No wheel-shaped ruff or rigid hoop skirt.

icons.name: Tudor gown
icons.prompt: An English noblewoman's Tudor gown from the mid-sixteenth century is displayed front-on without a wearer. It has a low square neckline, a structured fitted bodice, a broad conical floor-length skirt, and an open-front overskirt revealing a contrasting ornate forepart. Wide turned-back fur-lined outer sleeves reveal decorative undersleeves. Use deep burgundy velvet and gold brocade. No wheel-shaped ruff.

icons.name: Elizabethan gown
icons.prompt: An English noblewoman's late-sixteenth-century Elizabethan gown is displayed front-on without a wearer. It has a prominent white pleated wheel-shaped ruff, a stiff fitted bodice ending in a pointed waist, puffed shoulders, fitted long sleeves, and a wide structured floor-length skirt supported by a farthingale. Use richly embroidered silk with pearl accents, emphasizing the angular bodice and expansive skirt silhouette.

icons.name: Ancient Greek women's chiton
icons.prompt: A representative ancient Greek women's Ionic chiton has a long finely pleated linen body, a belt at the waist, and multiple small fastenings along the upper arms creating draped sleeves. Show soft continuous folds and an ankle-length hem. Display without a wearer, modern tailoring, or a rigid bodice.

icons.name: Ancient Greek peplos
icons.prompt: An ancient Greek peplos is a long woolen draped garment pinned at both shoulders, with a broad folded-over upper flap extending to the waist and a simple belt. Emphasize the shoulder pins and rectangular overfold, distinguishing it from a finely pleated sleeved chiton. Display without a wearer.

icons.name: Medieval kirtle
icons.prompt: A representative late-medieval European kirtle has a fitted laced bodice, a simple rounded neckline, close-fitting long sleeves, and a full floor-length skirt. Show a white linen underlayer at the neckline and restrained wool fabric. No wheel ruff, hoop skirt, corset worn outside, or fantasy armor; no wearer.

icons.name: Rococo robe à la française
icons.prompt: An eighteenth-century robe à la française has a fitted bodice with a triangular stomacher, elbow-length sleeves with lace ruffles, and an open overskirt revealing a matching petticoat. Panniers extend the skirt strongly sideways. Display without a wearer, emphasizing the broad lateral silhouette rather than a round Victorian bell skirt.

icons.name: Regency empire-waist gown
icons.prompt: An early-nineteenth-century Regency gown has a high waist directly beneath the bust, a broad square neckline, short puff sleeves, and a slender ankle-length skirt falling in light vertical folds. Use pale muslin with restrained trim. Display without a wearer, hoop structure, or pointed corseted waist.

icons.name: White bridal wedding gown

icons.name: Evening gown
icons.prompt: A formal evening gown has a dark emerald satin body, an asymmetric one-shoulder neckline, a defined waist, and a flowing floor-length skirt with a subtle side drape. Emphasize the long elegant silhouette. Display without a wearer, bridal veil, crown, or elaborate background.

icons.name: Cocktail dress

icons.name: Shirt dress
icons.prompt: A light-blue shirt dress has a pointed shirt collar, a continuous center-front button placket, rolled elbow-length sleeves, and a tied waist belt over a knee-length skirt. Display front-on without a wearer, emphasizing the single connected garment rather than a shirt tucked into a separate skirt.

icons.name: Satin slip dress
icons.prompt: A champagne-colored satin slip dress has two thin shoulder straps, a softly draped cowl neckline, and a simple bias-cut midi body without a visible waist seam. Show smooth flowing fabric. Display without a wearer, sleeves, buttons, lace underwear trim, or a separate skirt.

icons.name: Pinafore dress
icons.prompt: A charcoal pinafore dress has two broad shoulder straps, a square bib-like upper panel, a defined waist, and an A-line knee-length skirt. Display over a simple white blouse, without a wearer. Keep the skirt continuous, with no divided trouser legs or shorts.

icons.name: Sundress
icons.prompt: A cotton sundress has broad tied shoulder straps, a square neckline, a fitted waist, and a gathered knee-length skirt with a simple floral pattern. Display without a wearer, sleeves, shirt collar, or satin cowl neckline. Emphasize the airy everyday summer silhouette.

icons.name: Knit sweater dress

icons.name: Mermaid skirt

icons.name: Pencil skirt

icons.name: A-line skirt
icons.prompt: A smooth burgundy A-line skirt has a narrow fitted waistband and sides that widen steadily toward a knee-length hem, creating a clean trapezoidal outline. Display without a wearer, pleats, denim pockets, tiers, or a fitted mermaid section.

icons.name: Pussy-bow blouse
icons.prompt: An ivory women's blouse has long softly gathered sleeves, buttoned cuffs, and a long fabric neck tie arranged into a prominent bow with two hanging tails. Display front-on without a wearer, emphasizing the tied neckline rather than a pointed shirt collar or separate necktie.

icons.name: Camisole top

icons.name: Manchu dalachi headdress

Depict the headdress alone, without a face or body, and distinguish it from a crown or a hairstyle made entirely from hair.

icons.name: Manchu liangbatou hairstyle

A tall tiered gold finial rises centrally, decorated with small dragons and pearls and topped by a large luminous pearl. Show the complete crown alone in three-quarter view, emphasizing the fur brim, red tassels, and vertical finial. No European crown points, arches, or wearer.

icons.name: Crown
icons.prompt: A Ming emperor’s gold-wire yishan crown, modeled on the surviving Wanli imperial crown, has a rounded fitted cap woven from extremely fine gold wire into a delicate mesh. Two upright wing-like panels rise behind the cap, with symmetrical gold dragons facing a flaming pearl decorating the rear assembly. Show the crown alone in a rear three-quarter view so the mesh construction, raised wings, and dragon ornament are clearly visible. Entirely gold, without fabric, European arches, or long horizontal official-hat wings.

icons.name: Crown
icons.prompt: A traditional Chinese nine-tassel ceremonial mian crown has a fitted dark cap supporting a flat rectangular crown board, longer from front to back than from side to side, with a black upper surface and a reddish underside. Exactly nine parallel strands of small multicolored beads hang from the front edge, and another nine hang from the rear edge; no strands hang from the side edges. Show the complete crown alone in a front three-quarter view, with the rear strands partly visible behind the cap. Keep the bead strands separate and evenly spaced, emphasizing the rectangular board and front-and-rear curtains of beads. No European crown points, arches, fur brim, or wearer.

icons.name: Crown
icons.prompt: The Persian Pahlavi Crown has a richly jeweled gold-and-silver framework over a red velvet cap, with stepped ornamental uprights and arched supports decorated with diamonds, emeralds, and pearls. A prominent diamond sunburst centered on a large emerald adorns the front, while a white feather plume rises from a jeweled aigrette above it. Show the complete crown alone in a front three-quarter view, emphasizing the emerald sunburst, red velvet, and feather plume. No wearer, European crosses, or ermine trim.

icons.name: Crown
icons.prompt: St Edward’s Crown has a substantial jeweled gold circlet supporting four crosses pattée alternating with four fleurs-de-lis. Two intersecting gold arches rise above a deep purple velvet cap and meet beneath a gold orb topped by a cross. A thick white ermine band with black markings surrounds the base. Show the complete crown alone in three-quarter view, emphasizing its rounded arches, colorful gemstones, purple velvet, and ermine trim; distinguish it from the more angular Imperial State Crown.

icons.name: Crown
icons.prompt: A traditional papal tiara has a tall rounded white-silver body encircled by three distinct tiers of jeweled gold crowns, narrowing toward a small golden orb topped by a cross. Show the complete headdress alone in three-quarter view, emphasizing its triple-crown structure and domed silhouette. No wearer, bishop's mitre points, or European royal crown arches.
